rules.statement: Don't report a service collection variable or parameter named `services` as a naming violation unless the repository's own instruction files require a different name such as `serviceCollection`; when sibling code in the same project uses `services`, the code follows the convention.
rules.why: The maintainer declined the finding because no instruction file in the repository names `serviceCollection`, and the project's existing tests consistently name the collection `services`.
rules.check: Before reporting, search the repository's instruction and conventions files for a required name for `IServiceCollection`/`ServiceCollection` variables, and look at how sibling files on the main branch name them. Report only if a rule actually requires the other name and the sibling code follows it.
